patch_target: Complete AP archive (Magisk selects the required boot/recovery images)
notes: The /DS suffix is a dual-SIM sales variant; official firmware packages normally identify this family as A107F.
Use Samsung Download Mode/Odin protocol; do not assume standard Android fastboot support.
Patch the complete AP tar in Magisk instead of extracting and patching a guessed image manually.
Bootloader unlocking, when offered by the installed firmware and region, must be performed by the owner and normally wipes user data.
Do not flash A107M, A107G, A107N, or another A10s regional model package on an A107F device.
